comparison.objective: Tune and lock shock absorption versus aim and lock a loaded inspection arm at a target angle.
comparison.physical_skill: Both require stabilizing a mechanism while rotating a setting and locking it; the candidate additionally requires recessed hex-key use and feedback-driven retuning.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two acceptable dynamic impacts and post-lock retention; record requires a released arm within 3 degrees of 15 degrees for two seconds.
comparison.reason: This is the closest static adjustment analogue, but it tests target-angle positioning rather than tuning a dynamic response through repeated impacts. Candidate rebound, overload, and drift tolerances remain numerically missing.
